summary: Wire derived PARALLELS into corpus export; freeze CONTRASTS as a curated list
description: scripts/export.py emits derived_parallels output as the PARALLELS rows of the corpus dump (replacing staged-edge-promoted rows); the 112 live CONTRASTS become a small frozen/curated list carried through export unchanged. Snapshot-verified target shape: corpus.edges(source, target, edge_type, tier, weight, annotation); reader-panel SQL needs no change (verified 2026-08-13), though ORDER BY weight DESC in getRelatedPassages is a recommended guru-web follow-up since derived rows share one tier.
